business_summary: Marine Electricals (India) Limited manufactures and sells various marine and industrial electrical and electronic components in India and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Marine and Industry. It provides marine and defence solutions that offer power generation and distribution solutions, including main switch boards, automated power management systems, motor controkl centers/group starter panels/local starter panels, distribution boards, battery charger/transformer rectifier units, and navigation light control panels; internal communication systems comprising automatic telephone, self-powered telephone, public address-general alarm, sound reception, and talk-back systems; electrical and hybrid propulsion systems consisting of battery energy storage systems, air- and liquid-cooled drive systems, and motors and alternators; marine LED lights, such as automatic emergency lanterns, flush mounted lights/cabin, flood lights/hanger, pendant, explosion proof pendant, red pendant, weather deck, bilge, tube, bunk, and engine room lights; ancillary systems that include addressable flood alarm systems, wind speed and direction systems, all weather observation systems, data distribution units, and auto transfer switches; and marine motors that comprises brake, SPDP, FLP, winged, dual speed and three speed, salvage pump, and canned motors. Its defence solutions also offer integrated bridge and integrated platform management systems. In addition, the company's commercial solutions provide monitoring and control systems, and integrated navigation and communication systems. Further, it provides LV switchboards, MV switchboards, busducts and bustrunking systems, integrated powering solutions, and IBMS. Additionally, the company offers maritime domain awareness solutions, and mobility product and software solutions, as well as the Biz starter pack. Marine Electricals (India) Limited was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
